# sfcompute_image (Data Source)

Reads image from SF Compute (`GET /v2/images/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_image" "ubuntu" {
  id = "sfc:image:sfcompute:public:ubuntu-24.04-cuda-13.2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Image ID or resource path

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether this is an sfc-provided public image.
- `name` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a image resource. Format: sfc:image:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `sha256` (String)
- `upload_status` (String)
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this image belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace))

<a id="nestedatt--workspace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
